item.title: What Israel wants from an Iran peace deal: No enrichment, missile limits and strict enforcement
item.description: Israel wants Iran to stop enrichment, dismantle underground nuclear sites, restrict missiles and cut ties to Hamas and Hezbollah, experts say.

item.title: Iran War Updates: Tehran and U.S. Offer Conflicting Messages on State of Negotiations
item.description: President Trump said his administration had had “very good talks” with Tehran in the last 24 hours. An Iranian official said an American plan to end the war was under review. Israel struck targets near Beirut.

item.title: Middle East war live: Trump says Iran war will be 'over quickly'
item.description: US President Donald Trump said Wednesday evening that he believed the war in Iran would be "over quickly" but threatened to resume his bombardment of the country if negotiations fell apart. Earlier that day, the US military said it had shot at an Iranian oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman as it tried to breach the US blockade of Iranian ports. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut's southern suburbs, targeted 'top Hezbollah commander'
item.description: Israel on Wednesday unleashed the first air strikes in weeks on Beirut’s southern suburbs. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the attack, saying a top commander of the Iran-backed Hezbollah militant group was targeted in the operation. Read our liveblog to see how all the day's events unfolded.

item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.description: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: Southeast Asian leaders will reaffirm core values in veiled Mideast war rebuke
item.description: Southeast Asian leaders plan to issue a contingency plan that upholds international law, sovereignty and freedom of navigation in what could be seen as a veiled rebuke to the United States, Israel and Iran over the Middle East war which has impacted th...

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut for first time since Hezbollah ceasefire
item.description: Israel says it targeted a senior Hezbollah figure in the capital, the first strike of its kind since mid-April.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut suburbs, threatening already shaky ceasefire
item.description: The airstrike on the Haret Hreik neighborhood targeted the leader of the Radwan forces, Hezbollah’s elite and battle-hardened fighting unit, Israeli authorities said.

item.title: Iran considering US proposal as Trump says war will be 'over quickly'
item.description: Mediator Pakistan says it is "endeavouring to convert this ceasefire into a permanent end to this war".

item.title: Rubio says US military completed offensive operations in Iran
item.description: The United States said on Tuesday that it had ended offensive operations against Iran. But Washington warned it could unleash a “devastating” response to new threats in the Strait of Hormuz, as clashes and rival warnings from Tehran raised fears that a fragile ceasefire could collapse.
